expectations.text: Uses variant() with a variants map keyed by status, not manual branching
expectations.evidence: variant({ prop: 'status', defaultVariant: 'info', variants: { success, warning, info } }) — correct.

expectations.text: status prop type is derived from the variant definition via StyleProps
expectations.evidence: StyleProps<typeof statusBadgeVariants> used for the styled component and StatusBadgeProps.

expectations.text: Colors used for each status are semantic ColorMode tokens (e.g. background-success/feedback-success, background-warning/feedback-warning) rather than raw hex literals
expectations.evidence: Uses raw palette pairs green-0/green-900 (success) and yellow-0/yellow-900 (warning) instead of the semantic, ColorMode-adaptive background-success/feedback-success and background-warning/feedback-warning tokens that actually exist in the theme. These raw pairs are fixed and will not adapt correctly between light/dark mode the way the semantic tokens would. (info falling back to blue-0/blue-800 is reasonable since no semantic 'info' token exists.)

expectations.text: Does not wrap an existing Gamut component in styled() — this is a new primitive
expectations.evidence: Built as styled.span, not wrapping Badge/Tag/any existing Gamut component.
